asr_text: Awkward silence while your 11 labs agent thinks. Soft timeout plays a short filler while the model is still thinking. The docs recommend starting at three seconds. The default is disabled. You can set anything from half a second to eight seconds. Never put a time in the filler like one second, responses vary. Quick FAQ bought with fast replies. The docs suggest disabling it.
